title: Discovery triage + privilege log
description: Triage records and privilege-review completed branches while preserving failed-source envelopes.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: discovery-triage-privilege-log
  title: Discovery triage + privilege log
  description: Triage records and privilege-review completed branches while preserving failed-source envelopes.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Produce a reviewable discovery queue and privilege log with every unavailable source disclosed.
  policies: { maxConcurrency: 4, onFailure: preserve-completed, requireApprovalFor: [production-approval] }
  nodes:
    - id: records
      kind: input
      name: Collected records and review protocol
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required: [asset, instructions]
        properties:
          asset: { type: string, contentMediaType: application/pdf }
          instructions: { type: string }
        x-ladder-input-mode: document
    - id: triage
      kind: agent
      name: Triage responsive records
      templateRef: legal-05
      role: Discovery triage specialist who prioritizes review without making final responsiveness decisions.
      prompt: Deduplicate and prioritize supplied records by the approved issues, custodians, dates, and search protocol. Preserve provenance, list failed or unavailable sources, and send borderline items to human review.
      capabilities: { skills: [discovery-triage, evidence-provenance], tools: [read, search, classify], permissions: [read-sensitive] }
      outputSchema: { type: object }
    - id: privilege
      kind: agent
      name: Apply privilege rules
      templateRef: legal-04
      role: Privilege review specialist operating under counsel-approved rules.
      prompt: Apply only the supplied privilege rules. Record the evidence for each classification, separate uncertain items, minimize exposure of sensitive content, and require counsel approval before production.
      capabilities: { skills: [privilege-review, sensitive-data-handling], tools: [read, classify], permissions: [read-sensitive] }
      outputSchema: { type: object }
    - id: partial-fan-in
      kind: join
      name: Preserve completed and failed branches
      config: { join: allSettled }
    - id: production-approval
      kind: approval
      name: Counsel approves production and privilege log
    - id: result
      kind: output
      name: Discovery queue, privilege log, and failure register
  edges:
    - { id: e1, from: records, to: triage, kind: data }
    - { id: e2, from: records, to: privilege, kind: data }
    - { id: e3, from: triage, to: partial-fan-in, kind: data }
    - { id: e4, from: privilege, to: partial-fan-in, kind: data }
    - { id: e5, from: partial-fan-in, to: production-approval, kind: dependency }
    - { id: e6, from: production-approval, to: result, kind: dependency, condition: approved }
